mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.company_id, m.facility_id, m.indicator_id, COALESCE(f.facility_name, '기업 전체') AS facility, f.facility_type, i.category::text AS category, i.sub_category, i.indicator_code, i.title, m.reporting_year, m.period_type::text AS period_type, m.period_value, m.reporting_year || '-' || LPAD(m.period_value::text, 2, '0') AS period, m.activity_value, m.numerical_value, m.shipment_amount_million_krw, m.text_value, i.unit, COALESCE(m.additional_info ->> 'sourceSystem', m.data_source_type) AS source, m.data_source_type, m.status::text AS status, m.evidence_file_url, m.evidence_original_filename, m.evidence_content_type, m.evidence_file_size, m.evidence_uploaded_at, input_user.name AS assignee, approver.name AS approver, m.reject_reason, m.additional_info::text AS additional_info, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON f.id = m.facility_id LEFT JOIN users input_user ON input_user.id = m.input_user_id LEFT JOIN users approver ON approver.id = m.approver_user_id
ORDER BY m.reporting_year DESC, m.period_value DESC, m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC, i.category, i.indicator_code, CASE WHEN f.facility_type = 'HQ' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.facility_name
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON f.id = m.facility_id

choose.when: WITH candidate_periods AS ( SELECT DISTINCT electricity.reporting_year, electricity.period_value FROM esg_metric_data electricity JOIN esg_indicators electricity_indicator ON electricity_indicator.id = electricity.indicator_id AND electricity_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' WHERE electricity.company_id = #{companyId} AND electricity.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND electricity.period_value BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND electricity.status = 'APPROVED' AND electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 AND electricity.facility_id = #{facilityId} ), comparable_periods AS ( SELECT period.reporting_year, period.period_value, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_facilities facility WHERE facility.company_id = #{companyId} AND facility.operation_start_date <= (make_date(period.reporting_year, period.period_value, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE AND ( facility.operation_end_date IS NULL OR facility.operation_end_date >= make_date(period.reporting_year, period.period_value, 1) ) AND facility.id = #{facilityId} ) AS expected_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT electricity.facility_id) FROM esg_metric_data electricity JOIN esg_indicators electricity_indicator ON electricity_indicator.id = electricity.indicator_id AND electricity_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' JOIN esg_metric_data scope2 ON scope2.company_id = electricity.company_id AND scope2.facility_id = electricity.facility_id AND scope2.reporting_year = electricity.reporting_year AND scope2.period_type = electricity.period_type AND scope2.period_value = electricity.period_value AND scope2.status = 'APPROVED' JOIN esg_indicators scope2_indicator ON scope2_indicator.id = scope2.indicator_id AND scope2_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' JOIN company_facilities matched_facility ON matched_facility.id = electricity.facility_id AND matched_facility.operation_start_date <= (make_date(period.reporting_year, period.period_value, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE AND ( matched_facility.operation_end_date IS NULL OR matched_facility.operation_end_date >= make_date(period.reporting_year, period.period_value, 1) ) WHERE electricity.company_id = #{companyId} AND electricity.reporting_year = period.reporting_year AND electricity.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND electricity.period_value = period.period_value AND electricity.status = 'APPROVED' AND electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 AND electricity.facility_id = #{facilityId} ) AS matched_count FROM candidate_periods period ) SELECT reporting_year::TEXT || '-' || LPAD(period_value::TEXT, 2, '0') FROM comparable_periods WHERE expected_count > 0 AND matched_count = expected_count ORDER BY reporting_year DESC, period_value DESC

mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.action_type, h.from_status::text AS from_status, h.to_status::text AS to_status, h.comment, COALESCE(u.name, '시스템') AS actor_name, h.acted_at FROM esg_approval_history h LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = h.actor_user_id WHERE h.metric_data_id = #{metricId} ORDER BY h.acted_at DESC, h.id DESC

SELECT id, company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, activity_value, energy_cost, toe_value, peak_demand_kw, emission_factor_id, numerical_value, shipment_amount_million_krw, text_value, evidence_file_url, evidence_original_filename, evidence_content_type, evidence_file_size, evidence_uploaded_at, status, data_source_type, input_user_id, approver_user_id, reject_reason, hash_signature, additional_info::text AS additional_info, created_at, updated_at FROM esg_metric_data WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_metric_data ( company_id, facility_id, indicator_id, reporting_year, period_type, period_value, numerical_value, shipment_amount_million_krw, text_value, evidence_file_url, evidence_original_filename, evidence_content_type, evidence_file_size, evidence_uploaded_at, status, data_source_type, input_user_id ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{facilityId}, #{indicatorId}, #{reportingYear}, CAST(#{periodType} AS period_type_enum), #{periodValue}, #{numericalValue}, #{shipmentAmountMillionKrw}, #{textValue}, #{evidenceFileUrl}, #{evidenceOriginalFilename}, #{evidenceContentType}, #{evidenceFileSize}, #{evidenceUploadedAt}, CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum), #{dataSourceType}, #{inputUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_metric_data SET indicator_id = #{indicatorId}, facility_id = #{facilityId}, reporting_year = #{reportingYear}, period_type = CAST(#{periodType} AS period_type_enum), period_value = #{periodValue}, numerical_value = #{numericalValue}, shipment_amount_million_krw = #{shipmentAmountMillionKrw}, text_value = #{textValue}, evidence_file_url = #{evidenceFileUrl}, evidence_original_filename = #{evidenceOriginalFilename}, evidence_content_type = #{evidenceContentType}, evidence_file_size = #{evidenceFileSize}, evidence_uploaded_at = #{evidenceUploadedAt}, status = CAST(#{status} AS data_status_enum), input_user_id = #{inputUserId}, approver_user_id = NULL, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM esg_metric_data WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REJECTED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, category, sub_category AS subCategory, indicator_code AS indicatorCode, title, value_type AS valueType, unit FROM esg_indicators WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY category, indicator_code
SELECT id FROM esg_indicators WHERE indicator_code = #{indicatorCode} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT indicator_code FROM esg_indicators WHERE id = #{indicatorId} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT id FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND facility_type = 'HQ' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO esg_approval_history ( metric_data_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, comment, actor_user_id, acted_at ) VALUES ( #{metricId}, #{actionType},
CAST(#{fromStatus} AS data_status_enum) NULL , CAST(#{toStatus} AS data_status_enum), #{comment}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esg_metric_data WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT AND period_value = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT AND status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT i.indicator_code, AVG(m.numerical_value) AS average_value, SUM(m.numerical_value) AS total_value FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 1, 4)::INT AND m.period_value = SUBSTRING(#{period}, 6, 2)::INT AND m.status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY i.indicator_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_scores ( company_id, reporting_year, reporting_period, period_value, total_score, e_score, s_score, g_score, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{year}, 'MONTHLY', #{month}, #{totalScore}, #{eScore}, #{sScore}, #{gScore}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (company_id, reporting_year, reporting_period, period_value) DO UPDATE SET total_score = EXCLUDED.total_score, e_score = EXCLUDED.e_score, s_score = EXCLUDED.s_score, g_score = EXCLUDED.g_score, calculated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM esg_metric_data WHERE evidence_file_url = #{fileUrl} AND status = 'APPROVED'
